units.source_text: 鸨母拿着我付给的钱下楼去了，女人却还没有靠近我。

en.t: The madam took the money I had paid and went downstairs, but the woman still had not come near me.

units.source_text: 她是在把酒端上来的鸨母的催促下，才靠近过来的。

en.t: Only after the madam brought up the sake and urged her did she finally come closer.

units.source_text: 近看，女人的鼻子下方摩擦得有点发红了。

en.t: Seen up close, the skin beneath the woman's nose was a little red from rubbing.

units.source_text: 她似乎有个毛病，那就是她不仅搔腿，穷极无聊的时候，她总要在身体搔这儿搔那儿。

en.t: She seemed to have a habit: she not only scratched her legs, but whenever she was utterly bored, she would scratch one place or another on her body.

units.source_text: 鼻子下方这微微的红色印痕，说不定也是搔红的呢。

en.t: That faint red mark beneath her nose might well have been made red by scratching too.
